title: True fracture SPH — KW v35 Gc8k Extreme
description: Extreme stress corner: very high impact and low fracture energy. Phase-field fracture via SoliDualSPHysics; Gc=8000, impact velocity=35 m/s. Exploratory, not a validation reproduction. Blender 3D view uses mapped position + Displacement; visual thickness is added only for presentation.
